verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents lets you deploy code as programmatic participants that run on LiveKit Cloud and can process realtime streams or place outbound calls without a human driving them. That is a loose form of autonomous background operation, but the framework is built around realtime room sessions rather than general background automations. missing for 10: documented scheduling or event triggers for background jobs, unattended automation workflows outside live sessions, and independent or hands-on corroboration of autonomous background runs.
